integrity: Analytic proof of the exact boundedness set, compactness, and Hausdorff-dimensional trichotomy; finite checker is supplemental and not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: An explicit Hilbert direct-sum example rather than a classification of arbitrary semigroups. The factorial Cantor-set dimension method is classical related analysis; no new standalone number-theory theorem is claimed. An unindexed earlier equivalent semigroup construction remains possible.
title: Fractal imaginary-time boundedness for an immediately compact analytic semigroup
